findings.highlight: Something is slithering and squirming on the floor.
findings.evidenceJa: 密室の床には、何物かがずるずると蠢いていた跡
findings.governingReading: 跡 identifies traces of prior movement that Shinji recognizes.
findings.explanation: Tracks left by slithering things become things actively slithering on the floor.

findings.highlight: He's so ecstatic that he blurts out an answer which can only be a lie.
findings.evidenceJa: 誠実なまでに、嘘だけで固めた言葉を吐き出した
findings.governingReading: Shinji openly enjoys regaining Master status but delivers the lie 誠実なまでに, an ironic earnestness.
findings.explanation: An almost earnest performance of wholly false words becomes an ecstatic blurt.
